title: Akiyama Mizuki — Designing My Own Tomorrow〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks for coming, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There we go...! I'll start passing out the snacks and souvenirs Toya and the others brought back from the US!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was wondering what was in these big paper bags. They're all full of snacks and souvenirs?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, I was shocked too when Toya handed them to me. I was like, “All this?! Are you sure?!”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm surprised that he had them on hand, considering how sporadically you go to school.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Believe it or not, he asked the teachers about me. He made sure to bring them when he knew that I'd actually be there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: He seems like a nice person...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's Toya for you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I also got a bunch of stuff from Akito, so let me pass those out too while we're here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Then, let's get everything out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: First, this is one of the most famous American chocolate brands!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's cute. They're little triangles...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I'm sure we're all familiar with these cream-filled cookie sandwiches!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, these are the snacks you bring over every so often for our birthday and anniversary parties.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, right. These are originally American, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's right! And they apparently bought us some flavors that you can only get over there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: These are filled with peanut butter, and these ones are... Birthday-cake flavored?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Birthday cake...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you think they taste like?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We'll just have to try them and find out!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've set out everything I got, so try whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks. Then, let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Co.
rows.Line: Let's eat...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna try some of the chocolates your brother bought for you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Have at it. This one's in a thin bar, but it's apparently filled with caramel.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. It's really good...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Birthday cake flavor really does taste just like cake...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I really like these!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Ena, your brother and his team went over to see a music event in the United States, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was apparently pretty wild.
He said there were tens of thousands of people there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I heard a hundred thousand!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A hundred thousand... It must've been huge.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's a crazy number.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not only did they have a bunch of world-famous artists there, they covered a huge range of genres, they said. Sounds like it was a real blast.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the crowd apparently bounced off the walls the entire time! Their cheers sent shockwaves through the air, and they made the ground shake just by jumping in time with the music.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That seems possible, with tens of thousands of people.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If it was that amazing, I can understand wanting to see it live, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Me too! Man, I'm super jealous.
I wish I could go overseas for a vacation.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is there somewhere you wanna go...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Hmm... Not exactly, but still...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, but I might be interested in going to Europe since my big sis lives over there!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Imagine walking through a street straight out of the Middle Ages! I'd be like a fairytale protagonist!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... I'd want to visit Paris.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, there's nothing more photogenic than one of those super exclusive spas by the sea where celebrities go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! That reason suits you so well, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, are you making fun of me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I'm not!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What about you and Kanade, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Peru...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's a country far to the south of the United States.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
There are glyphs called Nazca lines there.
They're so big, you can only see what they look like from the sky.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I saw on the news the other day that one of Japan's universities is helping preserve them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: People talk all the time on TV and in magazines about how they're one of the Seven Wonders of the World! I can totally see why you'd want to see them in person!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What about you, Kanade? Is there any place you'd like to visit?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Umm...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Easter Island...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What's there?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's famous as home to the moai. They're huge stone statues with big faces.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting you to say that you were interested in seeing the moai, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Were you influenced by Mafuyu's Nazca lines?
They're both in South America, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
And there's something similar in Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Everything was delicious!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for sharing these with us, Ena, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: These snacks were really good.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Well, we're not the ones who bought them, really.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But this ended up being really fun because we got to talk about a bunch of stuff!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sure Sis will be coming back to Japan again soon enough, so we should be able to chat while having yummy snacks again!
